notes: Offer catalog and platform settings (RX-86, docs/credits.md section 9). Edit this file, then run `bun run seed:offers` (SEED_OPERATOR=<your name>).
Only decided values are filled in. null or a missing entry means not decided yet: the seed writes nothing for it.

Prices (priceUsdCents, monthlyPriceUsdCents) are in US dollar cents; the rupiah price is derived from the stored USD to IDR rate at quote and purchase, rounded up to the next Rp1.000 (RNX-53, D235, D237).
Decided (D237): the three top-up packs. Not decided (D1): every package version (price, credits, billing, limits) and every Enterprise bundle; packages wait for D1.
Not decided: demoRunsPerAccountPerWeek, demoRunsPerIpPerDay, demoOverageCapCredits (D43), projectionMinSpendCredits, projectionMaxDays (RX-30).
Packages stay inactive and hidden until they have a version. A changed version creates a new version; versions are never edited.
